ValidationRule.description: Blocks changing Lead Status to Qualified while Sales Channel or Sector is blank. Create Shopify needs a Qualified Lead, so both values are always filled first. Lead create and edit are not affected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), NOT(IsConverted), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Qualified'), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Sales_Channel__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Sector__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in Sales Channel and Sector before setting this Lead to Qualified.
